newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium's oldest is 110 and still keen on herring.
newsitem.headline: Belgium's oldest is 110 and still keen on herring.

text.p: Belgium's oldest citizen, Irma Vanderhaegen, marked her 110th birthday on Thursday cheered by flowers, champagne, herring and a visit from a representative of the Belgian royal family.
Born in 1887, Vanderhaegen, whose favourite food is herring, has survived her husband by 36 years. Her current offspring go back four generations.

Vanderhaegen is 12 years behind France's Jeanne Calment, officially the world's oldest person. Calment's status was challenged in April by claims from 62-year-old Lebanese Hammoudi Hussein that his father Ali Mohammed was 135.
